performance.verdict: Spend is live but every lead channel is dark — tracking failure, not market failure.

findings.text: lead_drought flag active: 0 leads recorded across all 28 days despite $1,066.61 spend and 12 Google Ads conversions — tracking is broken, not demand.
Booking bot battle-test overdue since 2026-07-31; intake owner unconfirmed since 2026-08-31 — speed-to-lead automations may point at a vacant dispatch seat.
Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating toggle all overdue as of 2026-08-31/09-01 — 5 undelivered SOW milestones in one window.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 5 consecutive days (2026-08-31 through 2026-09-04) after averaging ~4–5/day in August — listing may be suspended or unverified.
Google spend is erratic: 3-day signal (Sep 2–4: $13, $16.62, $22.79) vs prior 3 days (Aug 30–Sep 1: $2.73, $28.67, $86.87 then $97.13) — pacing is inconsistent, not deliberate throttle.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion actions and GHL form webhook — resolve 0-lead read before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 12 conversions over 28 days but GHL shows 0 leads — the two systems are not talking. Pull the active conversion actions in Google Ads, confirm the GHL webhook URL is live, and fire a test submission. Success means at least one test lead appears in GHL within 24 hours. Resolve by 2026-09-08; no budget changes until this is confirmed clean.

suggestions.text: Check GBP listing status immediately — 5 straight days of 0 actions after -92.5% weekly drop signals suspension risk.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for every day from Aug 31 through Sep 4, following a 92.5% week-over-week collapse. Log into Google Business Profile, check for a suspension notice or re-verification prompt on the primary listing, and do not touch the Crestwood profile. Success is confirmed 'Published' status and at least 2 actions returning within 3 days of any fix applied. Check by 2026-09-08.
